messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: PROD P1 — multi-GPU collective failures detected on colossus-prod. Many pipeline-parallel jobs seeing NCCL communicator resets and GPU XID errors. Paging oncall mira. Logs: https://redwood.internal/alerts/4321009999 :rotating_light:

mira (oncall): Ack. Jumping in. Which jobs? any customer-facing impact yet?

ops-bot: auto-alert: nodes affected: gnode-12, gnode-14, gnode-18. error snippets: 
```
[2026-03-15T02:13:21Z] CUDA ERROR: XID 79: GPU parachute reset - kernel launch failed
[2026-03-15T02:13:22Z] NCCL WARN: comm 0x7f...: peer 3 timed out (transport nvlink)
[2026-03-15T02:13:22Z] container restart: redwood-runtime-pp-456 (oom/killed)
```

sam (eng-runtime): Looks like the kernel reset is cascading into NCCL communicator timeouts. A pipeline-parallel job (model_id=rw-llm-13b-pp, job=pp-8812) was mid-step and lost ranks. Repro with small repro logs attached. My guess: nvlink transient faults + large KV cache causing OOM then process exit -> NCCL leader loss.

joanne (sre): If nodes keep flapping we should cordon+drain to avoid new pods landing. Suggest immediate mitigation: 1) cordon gnode-12/14/18 2) scale down PP replicas for that pool to 0 and failover 3) reduce batch size and enable CPU fallback for critical customer routes.

pradeep (infra): Cordon commands ready, running now: 
```
kubectl cordon gnode-12
kubectl drain gnode-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
# repeat for gnode-14 gnode-18
```
Applying env tweak to runtime DaemonSet: set NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SYS and NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0 for fallback to fabric. Pushing hotpatch to canary.

liz (support): FYI customer impact — support telemetry shows ~4.8% of inference requests returned 5xx within last 3m for customers: bluebox-inc, catalina-ai. Creating incident banner & support thread to notify.

mira (oncall): Executing cordon/drain now. Also rolling restart of redwood-runtime-pp on the remaining healthy pool instances. Reducing default batch_size to 4 for job pp-8812 via runtime override.

sam (eng-runtime): Quick config snippet to patch in rollout (applied to canary first):
```
# runtime config override
REDWOOD_RUNTIME_OVERRIDES={
  "pp_job_defaults": {"batch_size": 4, "kv_cache_mb_limit": 1200},
  "env": {"NCCL_P2P_LEVEL": "SYS", "NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME": "eth0"}
}
```
This should reduce KV cache pressure and prefer system-level p2p -> avoids direct nvlink paths that were flapping. Also enable 8-bit quantization fallback for non-critical routes: REDWOOD_RUNTIME_QUANTIZE=8.

joanne (sre): After cordon/drain we saw gnode-12's dmesg showing repeated ECC errors on nvlink port 1. Hard hardware suspect. I'll escalate to hardware ops for replacement.

ops-bot: action: canary patch applied to 2 nodes, no regressions observed in 90s. Metrics: latency up by +20ms, 5xxs down by 60% on canary traffic.

liz (support): Customer update pushed to bluebox-inc and catalina-ai observability channels. They asked if model responses were silently degraded — we advised rollback of quantized path for their traffic if they prefer fidelity.

mira (oncall): Confirming stability on canary for 12m. Proceeding with rolling canary->pool patch. Also kicking a job-level retry for in-flight PP jobs to force reconnection.

sam (eng-runtime): Note — need to add automated check to detect partial rank exits and trigger safe drain before full communicator timeout. Filing ticket RW-ops-2145.

pradeep (infra): Hardware ticket opened for gnode-12/14/18 with vendor. Replaced gnode-12 NIC & NVLINK cable scheduled.

joanne (sre): Handoff: mira — I’ll take next shift monitoring for 2 hours then hand back to ops oncall. Creating follow-up runbook updates for ECC + NVLINK cable checks.

mira (oncall): Thanks. Summarizing mitigation & impact: 
- Root cause: transient nvlink/ECC errors triggering CUDA XID resets -> container OOMs and NCCL leader loss.
- Mitigations applied: cordon+drain affected nodes, runtime env: NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SYS, reduced batch size, KV cache cap, enabled 8-bit fallback for non-critical traffic, rolling restart of runtime.
- Customer impact: ~5% 5xx for a subset of customers for ~12 minutes. No data loss.
- Next steps: hardware replacements, ticket RW-ops-2145 (auto-detect partial rank exits), runbook updates.

ops-bot: note: incident auto-close conditions met after 30m stability. Leaving thread open for hardware follow-up.

liz (support): Marking customers contacted and postmortem comms draft in #incidents-updates.

mira (oncall): Closing pager — handing monitoring to joanne. If any repeat events, re-open P1. Good work all :thumbsup:

joanne (sre): Taking monitoring handoff. Will post status update after hardware replacement.

incident-bot: Incident P1 -> mitigated. Link to timeline & logs: https://redwood.internal/incidents/4321009999/overview
